items.title: Identity & Progression Platform
items.rationale: Unified PublicPlayerProfile contract; remote profile viewing; guest-first identity; OAuth; cloud authority; titles; ranked foundations. Director approved roadmap 2026-06-19 — implementation NOT approved.

items.title: PublicPlayerProfile schema v1 + validator
items.rationale: Single multiplayer-facing progression contract (TS + JSON schema).

items.title: Server derive PlayerStats → PublicPlayerProfile
items.rationale: Denormalize public snapshot from authoritative stats store.

items.title: Profile visibility public | private + server redaction
items.rationale: Privacy opt-out before broad profile sharing.

items.title: PublicPlayerProfile schema versioning
items.rationale: Forward-compatible clients ignore unknown fields.

items.title: Push public profile on joinRoom / reconnect
items.rationale: Remote profile viewing — client sends snapshot at room entry.

items.title: Include publicProfile in buildLobbyUpdate
items.rationale: Single socket pipeline for roster progression data.

items.title: ProfileCache session map — single reader API
items.rationale: Eliminate duplicate fetchCloudPlayerStats display pipelines.

items.title: LobbyPlayerModal reads ProfileCache
items.rationale: Remote profile viewing — achievements + XP in popup.

items.title: Scoreboard + avatar borders read ProfileCache
items.rationale: Remove parallel GET paths; one contract everywhere.

items.title: Spectators receive roster profiles (read-only)
items.rationale: Spectator mode profile viewing without write path.

items.title: Document guest = install profileId model
items.rationale: Guest-first identity — preserve existing profileId architecture.

items.title: Guest vs signed-in UI in Settings + profile
items.rationale: Player-visible identity state.

items.title: Link guest → account stats merge
items.rationale: Upgrade path without forking progression.

items.title: Google Sign-In (web + Android)
items.rationale: Cross-device identity — post-RC OAuth track.

items.title: Map Google sub → linkedAccountId
items.rationale: Preserve profileId; link OAuth subject.

items.title: Sign in with Apple (web + iOS)
items.rationale: Cross-device identity — post-RC OAuth track.

items.title: Game Center + Apple Sign-In coexistence matrix
items.rationale: Document iOS identity paths without breaking GC users.

items.title: Authenticate PUT /api/player-stats/:id
items.rationale: Security — remove unauthenticated stat spoofing before cloud authority.

items.title: Store denormalized publicProfile beside stats
items.rationale: Cloud progression authority — server-derived public snapshots.

items.title: Optional server event-based XP ingest
items.rationale: Move from client max-merge blobs to signed progression events.

items.title: Client offline progression sync queue
items.rationale: Queue sync on reconnect after offline play.

items.title: Title definitions + unlock rules
items.rationale: Titles on PublicPlayerProfile — post-RC cosmetics track.

items.title: Cosmetic ids + equip slot model
items.rationale: Avatar flair beyond achievement borders.

items.title: Equip UI → updates public snapshot
items.rationale: Player-selected title/cosmetics visible in multiplayer.

items.title: Show title + border on seats from PublicPlayerProfile
items.rationale: Social progression visibility at the table.

items.title: RankedProfile schema (rankTier, rankPoints, seasonId)
items.rationale: Ranked foundations — data model only, no queue yet.

items.title: Server casual vs ranked result recording
items.rationale: Separate ranked progression from casual rooms.

items.title: Public rank badge on profile + modal
items.rationale: Expose rank tier without raw MMR.

items.title: Ranked matchmaking queue (deferred)
items.rationale: Explicitly out of ranked foundation scope — separate epic when ready.

items.title: Navigate mid-match Join spectators to GameScreen
items.rationale: Players use room code Join expecting live watch; server marks spectator correctly but client blocks navigation.

items.title: Wire release gate into deploy-web.yml
items.rationale: RELEASE_GATE.md recommends gate before build:web — prevents shipping broken multiplayer.

items.title: Mission Control Phase 2 sync-dashboard.mjs
items.rationale: Auto-derive P0/P1 counts from ARCHITECTURE_GAPS.md without hand-editing dashboard.json.

items.title: Product decision: instant round end vs trick acknowledgment
items.rationale: Penultimate out play currently requires last player to respond to trick — conflicts with some player expectations.

items.title: Align trick-pause display with live turn ring on BOTOPN
items.rationale: Presentation desync during trick-pause — winner appears not to lead next trick.
